listingTitle: Move BLoC side effects out of builders
title: Move BLoC side effects out of builders
why: Builders may run repeatedly and should not navigate, show transient UI, persist data, or emit telemetry.
suggestion: Use BlocListener or BlocConsumer listener for the side effect.
limitations: Generated, test, example, and vendored sources follow normal source classification controls.
Framework wrappers and behavior outside the analyzed repository cannot be resolved.
